name: Trouble Travel
source:
Five classmates - two boys and three girls go on a trip to a resort town. You play as one of boys and can go on multiple of dates with the girls you like.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
五位同学——两个男孩和三个女孩去度假小镇旅行。你扮演男孩之一，可以与你喜欢的女孩进行多次约会。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
